people.name: Antioch
people.line: A city in Pisidia where Paul preached the gospel.

people.name: Perga
people.line: A city in Pamphylia visited by Paul

people.name: Pisidia
people.line: A region in Asia Minor visited by Paul

translations.web: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.
translations.bsb: And from Perga, they traveled inland to Pisidian Antioch, where they entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and sat down.
translations.kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
translations.asv: But they, passing through from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia; and they went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
